items.title: The Next Monster Hunter Game Officially Gets a Release Date
items.summary: The next Monster Hunter game is out soon, although it may not be what you expect. Monster Hunter Outlanders is a free-to-play, mobile-only installment being developed by TiMi Studio Group. That may not sound particularly appealing, but before you dismiss Outlanders out of hand, it’s worth noting that, for a mobile title, what we’ve seen so far looks surprisingly similar to traditional entries in the series.
